title: Always Re-send Page Pictures
eyebrow: Proposal for the house-rules plugin · 16 October 2026 · built from a handoff

short.lead: The build plan for the importer fixes showed you an out-of-date picture, because republishing the page sent only its text. On claude.ai a page's pictures are separate files, and a republish keeps the old ones unless they are sent again. This proposal makes the house-rules plugin catch a stale picture every time. The plugin lives in Ajw2003/AjsClaudeCodeTools, and this session can't push to it. So the full brief is a handoff file for a session that can, the same way the label setup was handled.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it changes.
items: The page builder copies pictures into a folder next to the page. Versions 5 to 9 of the build plan page were republished with the page text alone, so the reshot pictures never went up. Version 10 sent all six pictures, and the published after-card was downloaded and checked.

before.alt: Your screenshot of version 9: the after-card still has a cut title and cut text

after.alt: The after-card published in version 10: an eight-word title and the whole note

items.caption: Before: your screenshot of version 9, where the old picture contradicts its caption. After: the picture published in version 10, read back from the page.

items: The page builder prints the pictures to send
After building a page, make_page.py prints the exact list of picture files for the publish, so sending them is a copy and paste.
The publish check refuses stale pictures

A republish that leaves out a picture changed since the last publish is refused. The refusal names each stale picture and prints the list to send. The plugin's own tests cover a refused republish, the same republish with the list, and a republish where no picture changed.
One line in the page rules
Republishing a page re-sends every changed picture, then reads one back from the published page to check it.
A session on the plugin repo builds it
The brief is docs/plans/page-pictures-handoff.md in this repo. That session follows the plugin repo's own approvals.

Say "start the plugin session" here, and I start a separate session on Ajw2003/AjsClaudeCodeTools with the handoff. In that new session, send "Design approved: Page pictures". Do not send it in this session: it would replace the importer as the feature this repo's design lock is tracking.

changes: Prints the picture list after a build.
Today it only says how many pictures it copied.
Refuses a republish with stale pictures.
It records what each picture looked like when it was last published, in a file that git ignores.
I re-send every picture by hand.
Each republish from this repo sends all of the page's pictures and reads one back.
